integrity: The result is proved by an explicit conjugacy of Gödel-model evaluation under endpoint-fixing order homeomorphisms and by an exact ordered-set-partition count. The 2026 primary paper was inspected in full text at its semantic definitions, witnessed/discrete-model definitions, finite-model theorem, and finite-value complexity reduction. Candidate-specific literature and published-finding searches did not locate the same frame-level regrading quotient or exact census.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula counts labelled regrading classes, not pairwise distinct frame logics. The canonical finite census applies to finite world sets and to the standard Gödel modal language without named intermediate truth constants.
title: Ordinal regrading classes of finite Gödel Kripke frames
